name: GitBranch
description: Switches the working tree to a branch, creating it first when create is true. The result is checked against the branch that is actually checked out.
title: Switch to branch {input.name}

create.description: Create the branch before switching to it

refuses.reason: it overwrites files of the working tree with the content of the index or of a commit, which discards changes that no commit holds

report: The working tree is on branch {after.branch}.
